Disclosure to Promote the Right To Information 

Whereas the Parliament of India has set out to provide a practical regime of right to 
information for citizens to secure access to information under the control of public authorities, 
in order to promote transparency and accountability in the working of every public authority, 
and whereas the attached publication of the Bureau of Indian Standards is of particular interest 
to the public, particularly disadvantaged communities and those engaged in the pursuit of 
education and knowledge, the attached public safety standard is made available to promote the 
timely dissemination of this information in an accurate manner to the public.

SPECIFICATION FOR TENONS 

(First Revision ) 



!• Scope — Covers the dimensions and otiier requirements for tenons for use with T-slots conforming 
to 18:2013-1985 'Dimensions for T-slot (second rev/sion)\ 

2. Dimensions and Tolerances — Shall be as given in Table 1 read with Fig. 1 to 3. 

2.1 To accommodate the tenon, a slot shall be provided in the fixtures as shown below: 



' V////. 




3. Typical assemblies of the tenons with fixtures shown for different sizes of tenons have been given at 
Appendix A. 

4. Material and Hardness 

4.1 The tenon shall be made from steel of grade 15Cr13Mo6 or 25Cr13Mo6 or any other suitable grade 
conforming to 13:5517-1978 'Steels for hardening and tempering (first revision)' y^hlch, after suitable 
heat treatment, shall have a minimum hardness of 42 HRC on the bearing surface. 

5. Designation — A tenon, having nominal size a = 12 mm shall be designated as: 

Tenon 12 IS: 2990 

6. Finish — The tenons shall be free from cracks, burrs, pits and other defects. 

7. Preservation and Packing 

7.1 A suitable anti-corrosive surface treatment shall be given to tenons. 

7.2 The tenons shall be packed in suitable cartons so as to prevent damage during transit. 

8. Marking — The tenons shall be marked at an appropriate place with type, size and manufacturer's 
name or trade-mark. 

8.1 ISi Certification Marking — Details available with the Indian Standards Institution.

EXPLANATO RY NOTE 

This standard was originally published in 1966. The committee responsible for the formulation of 
this standard, decided to revise the same. 

In this revision, following changes have been made: 

a) The original standard was for 'Dimensions for tenons'. In the revision, it has been made 
'Specification for tenons' and marking clauses have been incorporated. 

b) The dimensions 10-5 has been changed to 10*4 in Fig. 1 and 2 and the values 6-3 and 8-3 have 
been changed to 6-8 and 9-0 against h in Table 1 to suit IS:3406 (Part 2)-1976 'Dimensions for 
countersinks and counterbores: Part 2 Counterbores (second revlsion)\ 

c) The dimensions 6-4, 8'4, 10-4 and 13-5 in the figures (see 2) have been toleranced to H12 
and H13 respectively in line with IS : 3406 (Part 2)-1986. 

d) Relief grooves have been shown in the figures (see 2). 

e) The combination of the tolerance for dimension b in Table 1 and in figure for slot has been 
changed to H7/h6 as recommended in IS: 2709-1982 'Guide for the selection of fits (first revlsionY 
in slot shown under 2.1 for precision slide fit. 

f) A radius of 0*5 has been provided in figure under 2.1.
